Alphabet is a public company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States. It trades under the ticker GOOGL and its website is abc.xyz. The company's own site material is limited to an investor relations home page, which identifies the site as Alphabet Investor Relations.

The held record lists no products for Alphabet and no MCP servers. Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with 281 matters noted.
